Title: [JOURNEY] An operator's agent connects, asks for a restart, an approver rejects it, and the audit trail shows who did what
Preconditions: vcst-qa with VirtoCommerce.MCP, Admin Shell and System Operations enabled (confirm in GET {{BACK_URL}}/api/platform/modules; versions are whatever the stand reports, never pinned here). Accounts from `npm run seed:mcp-security` (the MCP_OPERATOR, MCP_APPROVER, MCP_MANAGER and MCP_NOROLE aliases); password = the DEFAULT_TEST_PASSWORD secret, typed by NAME in the Playwright lane. The stand's OAuth application for the admin endpoint is registered under Security > OAuth applications (VCST-6641) as a public PKCE client with explicit consent and {{BACK_URL}}/admin/mcp under Resources. SHARED STAND: no other lane may use /admin/mcp or the Agent tools switches while this case runs. SAFETY: restart_platform is the only approval tool on vcst and approving a change restarts the stand - this case never approves; every change it creates is rejected in Cleanup. Journey role differs from the model's V1 (super-admin) on purpose: the journey ends with Disconnect, and disconnecting the admin's own agent is forbidden on a shared stand. The V1 self-approval cell is MCP-015/016. [PRE] A client that completes OAuth 2.1 authorization-code + PKCE (S256) with resource=<endpoint> for the named user (scratch harness in the run folder). The runner has no such helper - scripts/lib/graphql-auth.ts mints password grants, and the MCP module is expected to refuse a token issued without a client (vc-module-mcp#1 §Authentication {SPEC}; not observed on the runner path for the admin endpoint) - so this case is agent-lane and NOT automatable until a helper exists.
Steps:
--- SCREEN: Agent (JSON-RPC, no token) ---
[HTTP] POST {{BACK_URL}}/admin/mcp, JSON-RPC initialize, NO Authorization header
[CAPTURE] the WWW-Authenticate header's resource_metadata URL as PRM_URL
[HTTP] GET PRM_URL
[CAPTURE] authorization_servers[0] as AS, resource as RESOURCE
--- SCREEN: Platform sign-in and consent ---
[NAV] the AS authorize endpoint (response_type=code, PKCE S256, resource=RESOURCE, the stand's client id, its registered redirect URI)
[ACT] sign in as @td(MCP_OPERATOR.email) with DEFAULT_TEST_PASSWORD
[ASSERT] the consent page is shown (client name, account, what is granted, Allow and Cancel)
[ACT] click Allow
[WAIT] the redirect to the client's redirect URI carries a code
[HTTP] POST the AS token endpoint (authorization_code + code_verifier + resource) -> TOKEN_OP
--- SCREEN: Agent (JSON-RPC, TOKEN_OP) ---
[HTTP] POST {{BACK_URL}}/admin/mcp tools/list with Authorization: Bearer TOKEN_OP
[ASSERT] restart_platform is listed and approve_pending_change is NOT
[HTTP] tools/call restart_platform with a reason argument "AGENT-TEST journey"
[CAPTURE] the change id as CHANGE_ID and the trace id as TRACE_ID from the result
[ASSERT] the platform answers GET {{BACK_URL}}/api/platform/modules with 200 before and 30 s after the call (it did not restart)
--- SCREEN: Admin Shell > Agent approvals (as the approver) ---
[NAV] {{BACK_URL}}/apps/admin-shell/#/mcp-approvals
[ACT] sign in as @td(MCP_APPROVER.email) with DEFAULT_TEST_PASSWORD
[WAIT] the Agent approvals screen loads
[ASSERT] CHANGE_ID is in the queue with a now -> after diff, the requester named
[ACT] click Reject
[WAIT] a confirmation dialog opens
[ACT] click Confirm in the dialog
[WAIT] the row status shows Rejected
[ASSERT] the row status is Rejected
--- SCREEN: Admin Shell > Agent audit log (as the approver) ---
[NAV] #/mcp-audit
[ACT] type TRACE_ID in the search box
[ACT] press Enter
[WAIT] the grid reloads
[ASSERT] one row: user = the operator, scope = admin, tool = restart_platform, outcome = PendingApproval
--- SCREEN: Agent (JSON-RPC, TOKEN_OP) ---
[HTTP] tools/call get_pending_change with CHANGE_ID
[ASSERT] status Rejected and the reviewer is the approver, not the operator
Assertions:
[STATUS] unauthenticated initialize returns 401 with a WWW-Authenticate header carrying resource_metadata; PRM_URL returns 200 {SPEC} -- PR mcp#1 §Browser origins: an anonymous request gets a 401 challenge pointing to the protected resource metadata (RFC 9728)
[BODY] PRM names an authorization server and resource = the admin endpoint {SPEC} -- PR mcp#1 §Authentication: bearer tokens issued for the scope's resource (RFC 8707)
[DOM] the consent page shows the client name, the account name, an "Allow" button and a "Cancel" button; no code is issued before "Allow" is clicked {SPEC} -- ticket VCST-6155 comment 2026-11-08 scenarios 1.1-1.3
[BODY] the token is accepted by /admin/mcp and tools/list contains restart_platform and does not contain approve_pending_change for a user without mcp:approve {SPEC} -- ticket scenario 3.1 and decision B1
[BODY] restart_platform returns a pending-change result with a change id and a trace id, and the platform keeps serving {SPEC} -- ticket scenario 2.3; PR mcp#1 §Approval with a diff: the call is stored as a pending change instead of running
[DOM] the Agent approvals row for CHANGE_ID shows a diff with "now" and "after" values and a "Reject" button; after Reject its status text is "Rejected" {SPEC} -- ticket scenario 2.3
[GRID] the audit row for TRACE_ID shows the operator as user, scope admin, tool restart_platform, outcome PendingApproval {SPEC} -- ticket scenario 2.4
[REL] get_pending_change(CHANGE_ID) reports Rejected with reviewed_by = the approver's user, which differs from the requester {SPEC} -- PR mcp#1 §Approval with a diff (approver of the scope); ticket decision D6
Cross_Layer_Checks:
[NETWORK] no 5xx from /admin/mcp, /ucp/mcp or api/mcp/* during the case
[ADMIN] every authenticated call the case made is present in the audit log (POST api/mcp/audit/search as {{ADMIN_EMAIL}}, by trace id)
[CONSOLE] no TypeError or JS error on any Admin Shell or consent page in the flow
Failure_Signals: Initialize without a token returns 200 or a bare 401 with no resource_metadata; consent page missing Allow or issuing a code before Allow; restart_platform executes (platform restarts) or returns no change id; the approver's queue is empty or has no diff; audit search by trace id returns nothing; Rejected status not shown to the requester afterwards
Cleanup: [TEARDOWN] the change is already Rejected (terminal). Sign in to Admin Shell as {{ADMIN_EMAIL}}, open Connected agents and Disconnect ONLY the agent of @td(MCP_OPERATOR.email); confirm TOKEN_OP is refused afterwards. Never Disconnect {{ADMIN_EMAIL}}'s own agent. Sign out of every Admin Shell session.
References: VCST-6155 · Archetype:LIFECYCLE · Technique:FLOW · Model:S1 · Check:C-01,C-02,C-03,C-04,C-14,C-15,C-17,C-18 · BSC-1,BSC-2 · Role:operator,approver

Title: Every scope answers an unauthenticated call with a 401 challenge whose metadata names the scope's own authorization server
Preconditions: vcst-qa with the MCP module; no token is sent in any step. Scope list is read from the stand, not assumed. Where a scope is registered but not served on this stand (vendor), its absence is asserted by MCP-023, not here.
Steps:
[HTTP] GET {{BACK_URL}}/api/mcp/scopes with an admin bearer (role {{ADMIN_EMAIL}}) to list the registered scopes; keep those served on the stand (admin, ucp)
[HTTP] for each served scope S: POST its endpoint (admin: {{BACK_URL}}/admin/mcp, ucp: {{FRONT_URL}}/ucp/mcp) JSON-RPC initialize with NO Authorization header
[CAPTURE] status and the WWW-Authenticate header as CHALLENGE_S
[HTTP] GET the resource_metadata URL from CHALLENGE_S -> PRM_S
[HTTP] GET {origin}/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/<scope>/mcp on the same host directly
[CAPTURE] PRM_S.resource and PRM_S.authorization_servers[0]
Assertions:
[STATUS] every served scope answers the anonymous call with 401 {SPEC} -- PR mcp#1 §Browser origins (401 challenge for an anonymous request); ucp scope on a closed catalog is the same
[HEADER] WWW-Authenticate contains resource_metadata=<URL of that scope's protected-resource document> {SPEC} -- RFC 9728 as cited by PR mcp#1
[BODY] PRM_S.resource equals that scope's own endpoint URL, and authorization_servers[0] is the origin the scope signs users in on (admin: the platform host, ucp: the storefront host) {SPEC} -- PR ucp#13 §MCP module handles / protected-resource metadata at /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/ucp/mcp
[REL] the document fetched directly equals the one the challenge points to {SPEC}
Cross_Layer_Checks:
[NETWORK] no 5xx from /admin/mcp, /ucp/mcp or api/mcp/* during the case
[ADMIN] every authenticated call the case made is present in the audit log (POST api/mcp/audit/search as {{ADMIN_EMAIL}}, by trace id)
Failure_Signals: No JSON-RPC response within 10s, 5xx on /admin/mcp, /ucp/mcp or api/mcp/*, a token or credential accepted where a 401/403 is expected, response body empty or not JSON-RPC
Cleanup: None (read-only).
